description:
Record the Tier 3 vendor decisions so they are not re-researched: ChistaDATA Cloud (services-led, spike only if an enterprise user brings an account), Elestio (thin ops wrapper, cheap spike candidate if Tier 2 stalls), Yandex Cloud Managed ClickHouse (deprioritize: sanctions exposure, RU-region residency, declining Western trial access), Alibaba ApsaraDB for ClickHouse (deprioritize: Enterprise Edition diverges from open source, painful non-CN trial access). Also record the explicit exclusions: cloud marketplaces (billing channels, not endpoints), ManageStacks/MSP wrappers (stock ClickHouse, use clickhouse-server), Gigapipe/HyperDX/ClickStack (observability over your own ClickHouse, not hosts), Qryn (dormant), Clever Cloud (no ClickHouse add-on), OVH Logs Data Platform (OpenSearch, not ClickHouse).

DECISION GATE: revisit any Tier 3 vendor only on explicit user demand with an account in hand. Revisit is a new spike item, not silent scope expansion.

Guardrails: this item is documentation-only; it creates no adapters and changes no code.
